description: This file defines the BatchStorage class for managing batch process data in Drupal, including methods for loading, creating, updating, deleting, and schema management of batch records in the database.

classes.name: BatchStorage
classes.description: Defines a storage handler for batch process data, managing database interactions for batch records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BatchStorage with database connection, session, CSRF token generator, and time service.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a batch record by ID, unserializing the stored data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a batch record by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a batch record with serialized batch data.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes stale batch records older than a specified threshold.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates or updates a batch record with a new CSRF token and serialized data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Generates a new batch ID, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: doInsertBatchRecord
methods.description: Inserts a new batch record and returns its ID.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the batch table exists and creates it if not.

methods.name: catchException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during database operations, propagating if the table exists.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the batch table.
